 "press": "LOS ANGELES, Nov. 28, 2026 - ANTIPOP, powered by broadcaster ANNA, is thrilled to spotlight Martin Strayd and his latest daily single 'Adhd I Can Do That (Travillen Disorder)' on Veg Anna Radio. The track channels the unstoppable energy of modern life through Strayd's signature blend of alternative rock, anti-pop attitude, and raw lyrical honesty, delivering a sonic anthem for anyone who turns their scattered brain into a superpower. Martin Strayd, an Australian lyricist, songwriter, and composer with a catalog exceeding 100 songs, has built his artistic empire one meticulously crafted track at a time, earning airplay across ten world radio countries including the Philippines, Australia, Ecuador, the United States, Chile, Canada, Indonesia, France, Thailand, and the United Kingdom. Veg Anna Radio serves as the daily singles hub driving that global wave forward, presenting one new Strayd release per day and connecting listeners to an ever-expanding catalog of rock, alternative, anti-pop, reggae, blues, dance remixes, and soundtrack themes that explore freedom, desire, rebellion, nightlife, and love.\n\nThe story behind Martin Strayd reads like a backstage rock-and-roll novel. Before becoming one of the most prolific independent songwriters on the planet, Strayd worked as a celebrity guitar technician in Hollywood, serving the rigs of Steve Jones of the Sex Pistols and Doug Fieger of The Knack during their peak years. That intimate vantage point inside the machinery of stadium-level rock allowed Strayd to absorb the creative pulse of genuine live performance, absorbing the energy that later fueled four decades of relentless songwriting. When he finally stepped out from behind the scenes and committed to his own artistry, the result was an extraordinary body of work that spans genres and decades while maintaining a coherent voice rooted in lived experience and artistic discipline.\n\nStrayd's daily singles rollout represents a bold experiment in artist-owned music distribution. Each day brings a fresh single from the catalog, creating a living, breathing showcase that rewards consistent listeners with discovery. The model mirrors the organic spread of word-of-mouth fandom rather than relying on album cycles or radio gatekeepers. Veg Anna, operating as both DJ Bananna and the station's promo desk, curates each drop with the warm, insider energy of classic FM radio countdowns, treating every single like a cultural event worthy of celebration and conversation. The structure has already resonated with audiences across multiple continents, as evidenced by the steady growth of radio partners playing Strayd's music around the clock.\n\nFor listeners ready to own a piece of this catalog, direct MP3 and cover art bundles are available through the official artist hub at strayd.com and via the dedicated download portal at tinyurl.com/martinstrayd. It is important to note that buyers who purchase these bundles own their copies outright and are encouraged to share them freely with friends for non-commercial listening purposes. This generous sharing policy reflects Strayd's belief that music should travel organically between people who love it. However, commercial resale of the bundles is strictly prohibited, ensuring that the artist retains control over the commercial distribution of his work while fans enjoy genuine personal ownership.\n\nThe reach of Martin Strayd and Veg Anna Radio continues to expand. With verified presence on Apple Music, YouTube, and the primary artist hub, the team has built a sustainable infrastructure for independent music discovery that sidesteps traditional gatekeepers. Each daily single is an invitation to explore the breadth of a catalog that took four decades to assemble, and today's drop 'Adhd I Can Do That (Travillen Disorder)' is one of its most infectious entry points.
